name: client-deob
description: This folder is the **whole workspace for one task**: converting the obfuscated deadshot client bundle into clean, feature-organized module files — without changing behavior.

scripts.pipeline: node tools/extract.mjs && node tools/emit.mjs && node tools/bundle.mjs && node tools/verify.mjs

scripts.pipeline-served: DS_CORPUS=served node tools/extract.mjs && DS_CORPUS=served node tools/reclassify.mjs && DS_CORPUS=served node tools/emit.mjs && DS_CORPUS=served node tools/rename.mjs --census && DS_CORPUS=served node tools/rename.mjs --apply && DS_CORPUS=served node tools/bundle.mjs && DS_CORPUS=served node tools/verify.mjs --level L2 && DS_CORPUS=served node tools/inventory.mjs && DS_CORPUS=served node tools/coverage.mjs && DS_CORPUS=served node tools/lint.mjs && DS_CORPUS=served node tools/behavioral.mjs && DS_CORPUS=served node tools/server-anchors.mjs
